newsitem.title: USA: Indiana bill seeks tax on professional athletes.
newsitem.headline: Indiana bill seeks tax on professional athletes.

text.p: - Visiting professional athletes would have to pay an Indiana income tax under a bill to come up for a final vote in the state House as soon as next week.

The bill, which was sent to the floor by the House Ways and Means Committee on Tuesday, would direct the Indiana Department of Revenue to collect the tax when professional sports teams play in the state.

John Schorg, a spokesman for House Democrats, said the measure, which passed the Senate last month, could result in as much as $2 million in income tax collections annually from non-resident athletes. He added that 15 to 20 other states already have similar income tax provisions.
